newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U shares tumble on fears over 1997.
newsitem.headline: P&U shares tumble on fears over 1997.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn shares took a tumble in afternoon trade on Thursday, slipping nearly five percent after steady gains earlier on the back of its report for the third quarter of 1996.
At 1445 the share was 11.5 crowns lower at 231.50 crowns.
"At an analysts' meeting this afternoon some questions were raised about 1997 and this caused some renewed nervousness," one London-based analyst told Reuters.
"The market is confident about the fourth quarter but then there is some hesitancy."
P&U's spokesman Jan Isoz told Reuters that finance director Bob Salisbury told analysts the consensus forecast on the market for earnings per share was slightly too high.
"The average forecast is around $2.35, and he (Bob Salisbury) said that it could be around 10 cents too high," Isoz told Reuters.
P&U shares rose to 251 crowns earlier in the day when the third quarter report backed the company's profit warning over adverse currency moves three weeks earlier.
P&U had warned currency moves could drag its earnings per share down to 44 cents against analyst hopes for 55 cents and this was exactly what was reported on Thursday.
